payload.text: LAKSA ON laksa-vc's GO, and not before. In Laksa's tree: `bin/devbin upgrade --from` the machine install, twice (the first pass runs Laksa's old runtime); stage exactly bin/devbin, bin/.devbin/lib and bin/.devbin/manifest.sha256; commit with --only through Laksa's gate, never --no-verify; send laksa-vc the sha, and laksa-dc runs check all.
